verdict.rationale: Mastra's GitHub README documents model routing that connects to 40+ providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and more) through one standard interface, which is the core of swapping models without rewriting the agent. A community user notes it is built on the Vercel AI SDK, consistent with a provider-agnostic abstraction. missing for 10: in-depth docs showing the actual swap mechanism (e.g. changing a model ID or config on an existing agent), hands-on or independent corroboration that switching providers needs no code changes, and coverage of provider-specific feature caveats.
